title: autoflashcards --json output
description: Written by export.write_json: the extracted text, the cards in the deck and the cards that were dropped.

blocks.description: The text extracted from the file, after headers, footers and page numbers are removed.

removed.description: The cards that were dropped, each with the reason.

headingPath.description: The headings above the text, outermost first.

page.description: 1-based page number; null for formats without pages, such as Markdown.

bold_lead.description: Bold text that starts the block, usually a term being defined; empty if none.

front.description: For cloze cards, the full text with {{c1::...}} around the hidden words.

rule.description: Name of the rule that made the card.

occlusion.description: Diagram cards: the boxes, in Anki Image Occlusion markup.

answers.description: Diagram cards: the labels as cloze deletions numbered like the boxes.

typed.description: Diagram cards: a box to type the label.

sio.description: Diagram cards: image and boxes for the Simple Image Occlusion add-on.

source_label.description: Where the card came from, e.g. "notes.pdf · p.12 · Cells › Transport".
